segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Well, I see a kitchen and a housewife, or homemaker, at the sink,

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: and her two kids are having a great time. She is... drying a dish

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: as her sink overflows. She must be blind, but that's her doing. Also, the kid is about to fall, having

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: gotten a cookie out of the cookie jar. That's the boy who's up on a stool, and the daughter is there

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: trying to grab the cookie, I guess,

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: It looks like a nice yard in back with a bit of a garden and some grass,

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: I believe. She's standing in the water. It still bothers me that she's gone blind, that she can't,

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: well, she'll feel it soon on her feet when the water hits her.
